C-74.IntentSummary: Close C-72 through a successor disposition: record the archive basis and the post-review stabilization states in evidence, move the C-72 bundle to the archive with only the status-attribute transition the archive convention requires, verify the lint boundary, then archive C-74 itself so the ledger ends with no consumed-baseline residue.
C-74.ExecutionPolicy: Execute sequentially. No parallel change-bundle execution while C-74 is open. The working tree already carries the reviewed FIX-wave and C-73 artifacts from the same stabilization session; C-74 does not touch, revert or adjudicate them — their landing is governed by their own bundles and the train ledger.

Corner.Name: Correctness — intact archival
Corner.Expected: The four C-72 files land in .grace/changes/archive/C-72/ identical to their committed HEAD blobs except the single status attribute transition approved→applied on spec.xml and plan.xml (the archive convention the linter enforces); nothing else in archive/ is touched.

Corner.Name: Correctness — lint truth
Corner.Expected: After C-72 archival and C-74 self-archival, grace lint --assertions current reports zero errors: the four consumed C-72 baseline assertions disappear with the bundle, C-74 leaves no consumed residue behind, and no active bundle gains a failure; warnings may remain.

Corner.Name: Correctness — honest states
Corner.Expected: evidence.json postReviewStates copies only facts already recorded by their owning documents (train ledger, follow-up epic, C-TABLE-FOOTER evidence): FIX-003..007 accepted on bae95a97, FIX-008 reopened, FIX-010/FIX-011 reported, C-TABLE-FOOTER partial acceptance with the Fit defect open, C-73 landing; no acceptance is invented or upgraded.

Corner.Name: Security and Privacy
Corner.Expected: No secrets, signing material, absolute home paths or owner-private data in the new artifacts; evidence contains repository-derived facts and public document pointers only.

Corner.Name: UX and Docs
Corner.Expected: No user-facing surface touched; the spec and plan follow the English-only policy and the anchor-tag convention (C-74 as the tag, metadata as child elements).

Corner.Name: Performance and Footprint
Corner.Expected: No build, dependency or test-budget change; the only gates are grace lint/status runs.

Corner.Name: Concurrency
Corner.Expected: The uncommitted FIX-wave/C-73 artifacts in the working tree are disclosed, not adjudicated; no file outside the C-74, archive/C-72 and archive/C-74 scopes is modified by this change.

Corner.Name: Lifecycle compliance
Corner.Expected: The archival follows the house rule that a bundle is archived only with a compliant plan and recorded evidence; C-72's own ReviewLog rounds F and G are the clean-review basis cited. C-74 self-archives with its evidence complete and its own status transitioned to applied — the same convention, recorded in the evidence file.

Corner.Name: Delivery discipline
Corner.Expected: Nothing is queued, admitted, frozen or published by C-74; the train ledger and the follow-up epic keep their authority over acceptance and release.

Corner.Name: Reversibility
Corner.Expected: Both moves are pure renames plus one attribute each; restoring the active paths reproduces the pre-C-74 state exactly, so a mistake costs one revert, not reconstruction.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: evidence.json records date, disposition archive-complete, the C-72 closure basis (executed; four-corner rounds F and G consecutively clean; the four consumed baseline assertions enumerated), the postReviewStates map with owning-document pointers, the concurrent-working-tree disclosure, and the self-archival decision with its rule.

T-002.Title: Archive C-72 with the status transition

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The four C-72 files are verified against their HEAD blobs (baseline.json and evidence.json byte-identical; spec.xml and plan.xml identical after the approved→applied status substitution), then moved to .grace/changes/archive/C-72/ with the active directory removed; archive neighbors are untouched.

Verification.Command: diff <(git show HEAD:.grace/changes/active/C-72/baseline.json) .grace/changes/archive/C-72/baseline.json && diff <(git show HEAD:.grace/changes/active/C-72/evidence.json) .grace/changes/archive/C-72/evidence.json && diff <(git show HEAD:.grace/changes/active/C-72/plan.xml | sed s/status=\"approved\"/status=\"applied\"/) .grace/changes/archive/C-72/plan.xml

T-003.Title: Verify the boundary and self-archive C-74

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: grace lint reports zero errors other than C-74's own consumed baseline assertions, and grace status lists no structural complaint about the archived C-72; then C-74's spec and plan transition to applied and the bundle moves to .grace/changes/archive/C-74/ with evidence.json recording selfArchived true, leaving grace lint --assertions current at zero errors as the outer gate.

Review.Findings: Correctness and Contracts: the four enumerated lint errors were re-derived from a live grace run before drafting (two graph-path MustContains, one train-wording MustContain, one C-34 archive MustExist) — they are consumed baseline assertions, matching the C-72 ReviewLog rounds F/G statement that the current lint equals exactly the consumed baseline. FINDING (fixed): the first draft let the diff-based intactness check shell-fail silently; the verification now compares each archived file against its HEAD blob explicitly. Security and Privacy: clean; the evidence template was checked against the publication policy — no ASC identifiers, owner backlog or promo planning in the public bundle. UX and Docs: no user-facing surface; English-only holds. Performance and Footprint: clean; only lint/status gates. The CornerMatrix (10 corners) was added before approval.

None outstanding after fixes: plan XML validates against the anchor-tag convention; DurableScope declares an explicit None (the first draft's empty element violated the lint shape rule — fixed); the TargetAssertions MustPassCommand invoking --assertions current violated the phase-compatibility rule (fixed: the lint runs as the outer gate in T-003 verification, not as an in-plan MustPassCommand); every acceptance criterion maps to a task and a target assertion; the execution policy discloses the concurrent working-tree artifacts without adjudicating them.

Executor walk confirmed the runnable surface (grace and node on PATH, HEAD blobs resolvable) and surfaced two execution-shape facts now baked into the plan: (1) archived bundles must carry status applied, so the archival step includes the single-attribute transition rather than a byte-identical move — the intactness corner and T-002 verification were amended to the sed-substituted comparison; (2) an executed C-74 left active would reproduce the consumed-baseline residue this change exists to remove, so T-003 self-archives C-74 with evidence recording the decision. Two XML typos found by the linter during drafting (mismatched MustExist close, mismatched T-002 close) were fixed.

Four independent passes over the executed change. Correctness and Contracts: the move executed as a rename; baseline.json and evidence.json verified byte-identical to HEAD; spec.xml and plan.xml verified identical modulo the approved→applied status attribute; archive neighbors untouched; post-execution grace lint showed zero errors beyond C-74's own consumed baseline assertions, exactly as predicted. Security and Privacy: clean — the new artifacts contain repository-derived facts and public pointers only, no home paths, no signing material. UX and Docs: clean — English-only holds, no user-facing surface. Performance and Footprint: clean — no build or dependency change, gates are lint/status runs. Lifecycle: the self-archival rule and the status transition are recorded in evidence.json; the terminal state (C-74 archived) leaves grace lint --assertions current at zero errors.
